scoring_justification: The checker refits the Birch-Murnaghan EOS from the agent's raw energy-volume data, recomputes E0, V0, K0, K0', and cross-checks derived properties. Electronic properties are compared to paper-reported values. This is a classic T1 recompute.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported equilibrium properties for each TaN phase (Table 1) and electronic properties (Table 2).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from Tables 1 and 2 of the paper: a, c, E0, V0, K0, K0', N_x, N_tot_EF, Löwdin charges.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper's published tables.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numerical values the paper reports as the results of its DFT calculations; they are the target for reproduction.

outputs.description: Raw energy–volume data points for five TaN phases. The checker will fit the Birch–Murnaghan EOS to these points and recompute derived properties.
Derived equilibrium structural properties for each phase. The checker will cross-check these against its own EOS fitting from the energy–volume data and compare them to paper-reported values.
Electronic properties: total DOS at the Fermi level and Löwdin atomic charges. The checker will compare these values to paper-reported results within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: All files must be valid CSVs with the specified columns. The agent may choose any suitable DFT implementation and pseudopotentials as long as the protocol (PBE-GGA, ultrasoft, plane-wave) is followed.

steps.description: CoSn derived properties: cross-check a, c, N_x against paper Table 1, and E0, V0, K0, K0_prime against the checker's own Birch-Murnaghan refit from the raw energy-volume data.
WC, NaCl, ZnS-B3, CsCl derived properties: a, c (where applicable) against paper Table 1, and E0, V0, K0, K0_prime against the checker's refit.
Energetic stability ordering: CoSn < WC < NaCl < ZnS-B3 < CsCl (more negative cohesive energy = more stable) from the fitted E0.
Electronic properties: N_tot_EF and Löwdin charges against paper Table 2.
